Subject: Vecor security roundtable - slot allocator & timezone matrix

Hi Sofia / Oliver —

Thanks again for the interest in a security review. To make scheduling efficient given the number of stakeholders on both sides (Vecor security, procurement, Redwood security, AE/SE), I put together a quick timezone/slot matrix and a proposed prep checklist.

Quick ask: can you confirm which of the 60-minute windows below would work for your team next week? We want Redwood security (Mina) + one SE (David) + AE (me) in the session.

Proposed slots (all in PDT):
- Tue 23 May — 09:00–10:00 (PDT)
- Tue 23 May — 13:00–14:00 (PDT)
- Wed 24 May — 08:00–09:00 (PDT)
- Wed 24 May — 11:00–12:00 (PDT)

If none of these work, share an equivalent matrix for your TZ and we’ll re-run.

Prep checklist (attached):
- Completed security questionnaire (Vecor provided)
- SOC 2 summary / third-party attestations
- Network diagram & ingress/egress port list
- List of data flows and retention requirements

Attachments: Vecor_Sec_Questionnaire.xlsx (please complete the marked tabs), Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf, network-diagram-v1.png

Agenda (60m):
- 00–10m: intros & scope confirmation
- 10–35m: security controls walkthrough (Mina)
- 35–50m: SE deep-dive on deployment/networking (David)
- 50–60m: outstanding Qs / next steps (procurement/legal asks)

Thanks — if you prefer a shorter 30m sync for an initial readout we can do that too, but our security team prefers 60m to avoid follow-ups.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

Hi Grace —

Thanks for laying this out. We can aim for a 60-minute slot. Our security engineering team is tight this week; current preferences below (Eastern Time):
- Tue 23 May — 12:00–13:00 ET (matches your Tue 09:00 PDT)
- Wed 24 May — 15:00–16:00 ET (this would be your 12:00–13:00 PDT; I know that's outside your proposed list)

Quick notes:
- Please include procurement (procurement@vecor.com) on the invite — they will ask about data residency, contract SLA windows and any pass-through liability.
- Our security lead, Oliver, would like a copy of Redwood's SOC 2 and any recent pen-test summaries ahead of time.
- Could you share a short (1–2 pager) readout of the technical checklist so we can route to our cloud ops?

I’ll check with my team and confirm which slot we can commit to by EOD.

Thanks,
Sofia

s.ramos@vecor.com
